highlights_headline: Upcoming changes modernize Uno integration and correct native callback, stream-lifetime, and rendering behavior.

breaking.title: Update Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: Native assets require macOS 11.0 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0. Managed iOS/tvOS minima rise to 14.0; managed macOS 12.0 and Mac Catalyst 15.0 remain higher. Raise application deployment targets to satisfy every applicable framework and native requirement rather than lowering them to the native floor.

breaking.title: Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7
breaking.body: Non-Windows Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses a raster fallback, returns null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering and migrate WASM builds to the .NET SDK. The Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed.

breaking.title: Keep SKData.CreateCopy lengths within the source array
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of depending on an out-of-bounds native read.

bullets.detail: Uses one-byte native booleans for Skia callbacks and four-byte hb_bool_t values for HarfBuzz callbacks, fixing false-return handling while public managed delegates retain bool signatures.

Binds internal bundled HarfBuzz function calls locally to avoid incompatible system-library preemption, such as when GTK loads HarfBuzz first. Exported hb_* entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged.

Automatic continuous frames follow Choreographer display callbacks while drawing stays on the GL worker. Explicit render requests remain independent; this also applies to MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop.

bullets.lead: Native shader and GLES upload corrections
bullets.detail: Rejects Raster Pipeline slot-count overflows and invalid runtime-effect types earlier, and disables Ganesh BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that are invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged.

Bundles Dawn C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling it on the application link line, avoiding C/C++ flag conflicts. JavaScript glue remains a link input; custom native archives must include the rebuilt support.

StringUtilities decodes by encoded unit width: ASCII for Utf8, BMP for Utf16, and a single code point for Utf32. Empty, multi-character, or multi-unit inputs are rejected; null byte arrays now raise ArgumentNullException.

Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to a borrowed stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that stream; the caller retains disposal responsibility.

Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation, HarfBuzz UTF-32 string encoding uses a pooled buffer, and feature-string formatting avoids a native allocation while preserving decoding.

Aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756. Rebuilds ANGLE from chromium/8118 and keeps packaged Windows PDB names discoverable; the declared WinUI runtime minimum is unchanged.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled WebGPU C++ support for application linking and rebuilt Uno views for Uno Platform 7.
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Isolated bundled Linux HarfBuzz calls from system-library conflicts and improved Blazor sample paint synchronization.
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Resolved contextual terminology findings in CI policy checks.
